narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The top row has two grey and three coloured bricks. The ratio is two to three.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The block has three rows, and the rows are not all alike.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>One row is not the whole pattern, so we must count every row of the block.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check, add grey and coloured together and match the total bricks in the block.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Then make sure the two terms share no common factor except one.
